epithet.ko: 1918~1921년 그루지야 민주공화국 정부를 이끈 그루지야 멘셰비키의 지도자
epithet.en: Leader of the Georgian Mensheviks who headed the government of the Democratic Republic of Georgia in 1918–1921

bio.ko: 1868년 그루지야 서부 구리아에서 태어나 바르샤바 수의학교에서 마르크스주의를 받아들였고, 1890년대 그루지야 최초의 합법 마르크스주의 단체 메사메 다시를 이끌었다. 1903년 멘셰비키 편에 섰고 1906년 제1대 국가 두마 의원이 되었다. 1917년 트빌리시 소비에트와 그루지야 민족회의를 이끌었고, 1918년 5월 독립 선포 회의를 주재한 뒤 7월 그루지야 민주공화국 정부 수반이 되어 토지개혁과 사회 입법을 이끌었다. 1921년 붉은 군대의 침공으로 프랑스에 망명해 망명정부를 이끌다 1953년 파리 근교에서 숨졌다.
bio.en: Born in Guria, western Georgia, in 1868, he took up Marxism at the Warsaw Veterinary Institute and in the 1890s led Mesame Dasi, Georgia’s first legal Marxist organization. He sided with the Mensheviks in 1903 and sat in the First State Duma in 1906. In 1917 he chaired the Tbilisi Soviet and the National Council of Georgia; in May 1918 he headed the session that declared independence, and from July he led the government of the Democratic Republic of Georgia, carrying out land reform and social legislation. After the Red Army invasion of 1921 he went into exile in France, led the government-in-exile and died near Paris in 1953.

bio.en: Born to a noble family in Martvili in 1881, he joined the Social Democratic movement as a student at Moscow University, became a Menshevik and sat in the Third State Duma from 1907 to 1912. From November 1917 to March 1918 he chaired the Transcaucasian Commissariat, then served as minister of war under the Transcaucasian Sejm. He signed the Georgian declaration of independence in May 1918 and was foreign minister, justice minister and deputy head of government of the Democratic Republic of Georgia. He left for France in March 1921 and from 1953 until his death in Paris in 1954 headed the government in exile.

bio.en: Born near Baku in 1884, he founded Hummet, a Muslim social-democratic organization, in 1904. He took part in the Iranian Constitutional Revolution in 1909, and after returning to Baku in 1913 he became the chief of Musavat. As head of the Azerbaijani National Council he declared the independence of the Azerbaijan Republic on 28 May 1918. After the republic fell in 1920 he directed resistance until his arrest, but because he had once hidden Joseph Stalin from the police he was released and taken to Moscow. He escaped to Finland in 1922, lived in exile in Turkey, Poland and Romania, and died in Ankara in 1955.

bio.en: Born in Tbilisi in 1874 to a prominent Armenian family of noble origins, he trained as a doctor, was mayor of Tbilisi from 1910 to 1917 and in 1914 organized the Armenian volunteer detachments. He joined the Dashnaktsutyun in 1917. As foreign minister of the Republic of Armenia he signed the Treaty of Batum in June 1918, and he was prime minister from May 1919 until he resigned after the May Uprising of 1920. On 3 December 1920 a delegation led by him signed the Treaty of Alexandropol with Kâzım Karabekir, but power had already passed to the Soviet authorities and the treaty is held to be invalid. He went into exile in Paris and died there in 1945.

bio.ko: 1865년 오스만 제국 샤빈카라히사르에서 태어나 다슈나크의 페다이 부대를 이끌었고, 제1차 세계대전 때 러시아군의 제1아르메니아 의용대대를 지휘했다. 아르메니아 공화국과 바투미 조약을 인정하지 않은 그는 1918년 특별타격사단을 이끌고 잔게주르를 장악했다. 역사가 도널드 블록섬은 그가 무슬림 마을을 파괴해 이 지역을 아르메니아인만의 땅으로 바꾸려 했다고 보고, 안트라니그 찰라비안은 그가 잔게주르의 아르메니아인을 지켰다고 본다. 1918년 12월 영국군의 요청으로 카라바흐 진격을 멈추었고, 1919년 부대를 해산했다. 1927년 미국 프레즈노에서 숨졌다.
bio.en: Born in Shabin-Karahisar in the Ottoman Empire in 1865, he led fedayi units of the Dashnaktsutyun and in the First World War commanded the first Armenian volunteer battalion of the Russian army. Refusing to recognize the Republic of Armenia or the Treaty of Batum, he took control of Zangezur with his Special Striking Division in 1918. The historian Donald Bloxham writes that he sought to make it homogeneously Armenian by destroying Muslim villages, while Antranig Chalabian argues that he saved Zangezur’s Armenians from annihilation. In December 1918 he halted his advance into Karabakh at British request, and in 1919 he disbanded his unit. He died in Fresno, California, in 1927.

bio.ko: 1865년 스위스 로잔에서 태어나 러디어드 키플링과 같은 학교를 다녔고, 키플링의 소설 속 「스토키」의 모델이 되었다. 영국령 인도군 장교로 북서변경과 중국에서 복무했다. 1917년 말 메소포타미아 전선 등에서 뽑은 1,000명 미만의 연합군 부대 던스터포스의 지휘관이 되어 1918년 1월 바그다드를 출발해 페르시아를 가로질렀다. 1918년 8월 센트로카스피 독재 정부가 장악한 바쿠의 방어에 나섰으나, 9월 14일 오스만군의 공세 앞에서 바쿠를 버리고 물러났다. 1946년 잉글랜드 데번주에서 숨졌다.
bio.en: Born in Lausanne in 1865, he went to school with Rudyard Kipling and was the model for “Stalky” in Kipling’s stories. An officer of the British Indian Army, he served on the North-West Frontier and in China. At the end of 1917 he was given command of Dunsterforce, an Allied force of fewer than 1,000 men drawn from the Mesopotamian and other fronts, which left Baghdad in January 1918 and crossed Persia. In August 1918 he took up the defence of Baku, then held by the Centro Caspian Dictatorship, but on 14 September he abandoned the city before the Ottoman assault. He died in Devon, England, in 1946.

epithet.ko: 터키 독립전쟁 동부 전선 사령관으로 1920년 아르메니아를 침공해 알렉산드로폴 조약을 받아 낸 장군
epithet.en: Eastern Front commander of the Turkish War of Independence who invaded Armenia in 1920 and imposed the Treaty of Alexandropol

bio.ko: 1882년 이스탄불에서 태어나 오스만 육군대학을 수석으로 졸업했고, 제1차 세계대전 때 갈리폴리와 쿠트, 캅카스 전선에서 싸웠다. 무스타파 케말의 국민운동에 가담해 독립전쟁의 동부 전선을 지휘했다. 1920년 9월 아르메니아를 침공해 카르스와 알렉산드로폴을 점령했고, 이 원정에서 그의 군대는 아르메니아 민간인 수만 명을 쫓아내고 학살했다. 12월 알렉산드로폴 조약에, 1921년 카르스 조약에 서명했다. 1924년 첫 야당 진보공화당을 세웠으나 당이 폐쇄되었고, 1946년 대국민의회 의장이 되어 1948년 재임 중 숨졌다.
bio.en: Born in Istanbul in 1882, he graduated at the top of his class from the Ottoman Military College and fought at Gallipoli, at Kut and on the Caucasus front in the First World War. Joining Mustafa Kemal’s national movement, he commanded the Eastern Front in the War of Independence. He invaded Armenia in September 1920 and took Kars and Alexandropol; during the campaign his army displaced and massacred tens of thousands of Armenian civilians. He signed the Treaty of Alexandropol in December and the Treaty of Kars in 1921. In 1924 he founded the Progressive Republican Party, the first opposition party, which was closed; elected speaker of the Grand National Assembly in 1946, he died in office in 1948.

Karabekir was appointed commander of the 2nd Corps on the Caucasus front and fought bitterly against the Russian and Armenian forces for almost ten months.

He was elected speaker of the parliament on 5 August 1946. He died in office at the age of 66 on 26 January 1948 in Ankara after a heart attack.

epithet.en: Avar religious leader and mufti of the North Caucasus who led anti-Bolshevik uprisings in Dagestan and Chechnya in 1918–1925

bio.ko: 1859년 다게스탄 고초브 마을의 아바르인 귀족 지주 집안에서 태어난 이슬람 학자다. 1917년 5월 북캅카스 산악민 연합 대회에서 북캅카스의 무프티가 되었고, 8월 다게스탄·체첸의 이맘으로 추대되었다가 사흘 만에 칭호를 내려놓았다. 1918년 볼셰비키와 싸웠고, 1919년 데니킨의 의용군을 공산주의자보다 덜한 악으로 보고 협력했다. 1920년 9월 다게스탄 봉기를 일으켜 이끌었으나 봉기는 1921년 5월 진압되었다. 체첸으로 옮겨 다시 봉기를 준비하다 1925년 9월 체포되어 그해 10월 총살되었다.
bio.en: Born in 1859 to an aristocratic Avar landowning family in the village of Gotsob in Dagestan, he was an Islamic scholar. In May 1917 the congress of the Union of Highlanders of the North Caucasus made him mufti of the North Caucasus, and in August he was proclaimed Imam of Dagestan and Chechnya but gave up the title three days later. He fought the Bolsheviks in 1918, and in 1919 he collaborated with Denikin’s Volunteer Army as a lesser evil than the communists. In September 1920 he raised and led the Dagestan uprising, which was put down in May 1921. Moving to Chechnya to prepare another rising, he was arrested in September 1925 and shot that October.
